author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕೇಳಿತಿಳಿದಳವಡಿಸು ಅನುಭವದ ಜನ್ಯಗಳ
ತಾಳುಮೆಯು ನಿನಗಿರಲು ಲಭಿಸುವುದು ಎಲ್ಲ
ಕೇಳುಗನ ಚಿತ್ತದಲಿ ಶರಣೆನುವ ಭಾವವಿರೆ
ಬಾಳೆಂದು ಬಂಗಾರ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Listen, learn and adopt what is born of experience;
if you have patience, you will get everything;
if the listener’s mind has the spirit of surrender,
life is always golden, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Learn from experience by listening carefully and putting it into practice. With patience and a humble, receptive mind, life becomes precious.
